_comment: coeff = 0 control. Same 6 vectors, same datasets, same code path as the sweep configs,
but the hook adds 0 * direction -- a true no-op. Exists to remove a length confound:
the cached SAE/results/*.jsonl baseline was generated with different max_new_tokens
(median 327 words vs ~220 here), so keyword/judge rates are not comparable to it.
'coeff' is set explicitly, which makes resolve_coeff bypass the p90 lookup entirely
All 6 vectors are functionally identical at coeff 0, so this doubles as a replicate set:
with temperature 0.7 the 6 runs differ only by sampling, giving a null distribution for
every metric. Any steered effect must exceed the spread across these 6 to count.
Run with the SAME --limit and --max-new-tokens as the sweep being compared:
